assets.name: Aqeeq
assets.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. One premium 3D studio-rendered loose Aqeeq gemstone for Wilayah Stone's interactive stone collection. Subject: an oval domed deep carnelian-red agate cabochon, warm translucent edges, delicate internal stone texture. Exactly ONE stone, absolutely no ring, no metal setting, no engravings, no letters, no people, no faces or hands. Square 1:1 composition. The entire stone floats in the centre with 16% generous empty margins, rotated about 15 degrees above a three-quarter viewing angle so its depth and silhouette are clear. Consistent soft studio key light from upper left and gentle fill from right, refined physically based material, crisp surface detail, believable refraction or opaque finish appropriate to this stone, no exaggerated sparkle, no glowing halo, no lens flare. Transparent background with a very soft subtle translucent shadow beneath the stone. No floor, no opaque backdrop, no text, labels, watermark or props. Match a cohesive premium jewellery catalogue: clean, restrained, high-resolution and beautifully sculptural.
